name: Love Offerings
overview: Love offerings in Scripture reflect a heartfelt giving that honors God, exemplified by Abel's offering of the firstlings of his flock which found favor with the Lord. Such giving is characterized by generosity and trust in God's provision, as seen in the call to bring tithes into the storehouse and the promise of blessings poured out in abundance. Jesus teaches that true treasure is not earthly wealth but the generous giving that results in blessings returned in good measure, emphasizing the spiritual principle behind sacrificial giving rather than mere obligation.
